review: The clearing and depth bands are legible. Foreground foliage frames the sides rather than the overhead arch in the reference.
Cloud forms are coarse and graphic; the ground path remains broad near the camera. Generic shrub forms are grass-derived, not species models.
Custom foliage does not adopt all standard Three.js fog behavior; farther tree color grading remains a potential follow-up.
Stop after this first visual pass; no automatic polish, deployment or broad benchmark.
